class.name: IfcStructuralSurfaceMemberVarying
class.brief_description: Definition from IAI: Describes surface members with varying section properties. The properties are provided by means of a property set and IfcRelDefinesByProperties or by means of aggregation: An instance of IfcStructuralSurfaceMemberVarying may be composed of two or more instances of IfcStructuralSurfaceMember with differing section properties.
